Signed-off-by: Andrii-Yosafat Lozovyi <andrii-yosafatx.lozovyi@intel.com>

Summary: `show_techsupport/test_auto_techsupport.py::TestAutoTechSupport::test_max_limit[core]` fails with below error:
```
           AssertionError: New expected techsupport file was not generated
E           assert False
E            +  where False = wait_until(300, 10, 0, is_new_techsupport_file_generated, <MultiAsicSonicHost 7-dut>, [])
```
On some platforms time needed to generate auto_techsupport dump may take up `~ 15 min or more.` Reason for this is that on some platforms, amount of space dedicated to root-overlay could be up `to 100 Gb or more`, in such case 5 dummy core dumps will be created each with 5% of space, this will resolve in `25 Gb of core dumps`.
During auto_techsupport generation, `core dumps is copied inside of techsupport dump`, and taking in account the size of core dumps, it will take a significant time for this to happen.

This PR will limit the `one_file_size_in_percent to 1%` if one_percent_in_mb is more than 300 MB and test_mode is core.
Fixes #7130
